name: Tianjin Mahjong
description: Tianjin Mahjong is a Chinese regional Mahjong variant associated with Tianjin and commonly played without flower tiles. It uses a compact classical tile base and emphasizes local validity and scoring conventions.

setup.deck: 136-tile Mahjong set with suited tiles and honors; flowers and seasons removed.
setup.dealing: Each player receives 13 tiles; dealer receives 14 and discards first.

rules.objective: Complete a legal winning hand under the active Tianjin scoring profile.
rules.gameplay: Players draw and discard in turn. Discards may be claimed for legal sets under claim priority rules. A player wins when a valid complete hand satisfies profile constraints.
keyRules: Draw then discard is the core loop.
Claims must follow legal set and priority constraints.
Winning requires profile-valid complete hand structure.
